'''Hidesplitter's Spear''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] obtained from [[Hidesplitter's Chest]], which appears after defeating [[Rragar Maneater]] and [[Hidesplitter]]  in [[Rragar's Menagerie]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Draconic Spear]] in its default [[dye|colors]].
